speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: Hello. How are you today? If you have the time, I would like to talk with you about a charity.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: I am well today thank you. I would be happy to listen.

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: Thank you. Do you know the organization Save the Children?

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: I do not. What do they do?

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: Save the Children is an international non-governmental organization. They work for children's rights, helps support children in developing countries.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: That sounds like a great cause.

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: It really is. They work so the chieldren can have access to health, education, safety. In developing countries like Syria, millions of children have grown up facing the daily threat of violence.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: I feel very bad for the children in Syria. I can't imagine what they are going through. Helping them is very important as is helping our children here.

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: I agree. And sometimes even a small help is a lot, thinking many others will do the same.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: I agree with that. Does this organization spend the majority of their donations on the cause or are the higher ups lining their pockets?

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: Ah, a rightful question. This really is a trustworthy organization and they do work for the children. Actually, you can get more information about the organization from their website:  URL

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: The website says that 86% of funds go to the cause. That's a really good number considering the overhead that must be required for international relief.

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: You are right. This is a trustable fund. Would you care to donate a little bit for the children?

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: What are my options for donation? How can I donate and how much?

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: How much do you like to donate to the charity now? Your donation will be directly deducted from your task payment. You can choose any amount from $0 to all your payment ($2).

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: Thank you. I would like to donate $0.30 today.

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: Thank you very much! The children from around the world will surely be thankful as well.

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: You are very welcome. Thank you for telling me about this organization.

speaker: AISNLDPD2DFEG
text: Have a great day!

speaker: A3PL7JEMIPFHI9
text: You as well.
